remarks: Situated on a cul-de-sac in a prime location, this sizeable, 2,216 square foot home, offers four bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, and wonderful curb appeal. With the major mechanicals replaced within the past five years, you can settle in with confidence. Recent updates include siding, a tear-off roof, furnace, hot water tank, and sump pump, while the main electrical panel was replaced in 2018. Step inside through the inviting foyer, complete with a coat closet, and into a generous living room with neutral wall-to-wall carpeting. The eat-in kitchen offers plenty of cabinet space plus includes all stainless steel appliances. Its open layout flows easily into the formal dining room, making gatherings a pleasure, and continues to a cozy family room with a wood-burning fireplace. From there, a new sliding door leads to the deck and an expansive, fully fenced yard with a shed—an ideal setting for relaxing and enjoying time outdoors. All four bedrooms are impressively spacious. The primary bedroom features a walk-in closet and private bathroom, while other bedrooms offer full-wall closets. The dry basement includes built-in shelving.  Ready for your personal touches, this welcoming home is just minutes from Sunshine Park, Firemen’s Park, and everyday amenities. Showings begin immediately.
